rules.title: Respect fellow fans
rules.body: Debate opinions freely; no harassment, discrimination, threats or personal attacks.

rules.title: Protect spoilers
rules.body: Use Telegram spoiler formatting and name the film, show or game outside the hidden text. Keep major reveals out of topic titles.

rules.title: Use the matching topic
rules.body: Gaming, Movies, Lore, Memes, Wallpapers and events belong in their respective topics.

rules.title: No spam or scams
rules.body: Avoid repeated promotions, suspicious links and unsolicited sales. Ask an admin before advertising.

rules.title: Credit creators
rules.body: Link to the original artist or source when sharing artwork, wallpapers and memes. Do not claim someone else's work.

rules.title: Share reliable event details
rules.body: Include an organiser link, date, location and Hong Kong time where relevant. Clearly label rumours and unofficial meetups.

rules.title: Respect privacy
rules.body: Do not share someone's personal information or private messages without permission.

rules.title: Keep moderation human-led
rules.body: The bot may flag concerns, but deletion, restrictions and bans require the group owner's approval.
